summary_zh: 本页为绘本《逃跑的长颈鹿便盆》的封面，展示了书名、作者、插画师、出版社及系列名称，画面中有一个小女孩、一个长颈鹿造型的便盆和一个拟人化的马桶手拉手，营造出温馨友好的氛围。

page_text_ocr_zh:
夏夏玩得开心时，总是会忘记拉屁屁。
妈妈每次催她时，她都有许多借口：“等一下，搭完积木就去！”“看完电视就去！”
但是，等夏夏搭完积木或看完电视后，她又不想拉了。
page_text_en:
When Xiaxia is having fun playing, she always forgets to go to the bathroom.
When her mom urges her, she has many excuses: "Just a minute, I'll go after I finish building with the blocks!" "I'll go after I finish watching TV!"
But then, after Xiaxia finishes building with the blocks or finishes watching TV, she doesn't want to go anymore.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了小女孩夏夏在玩耍时总是忘记上厕所，妈妈催促她时她会找各种借口，但等她玩完后又不想去了。

page_text_ocr_zh:
妈妈只好给夏夏买来了一个长颈鹿便盆，希望她只要一有便意，就能立刻坐在便盆上开始拉屎屎。
可是，夏夏却把长颈鹿便盆当成了玩具，一会儿当成“小木马”，一会儿又当成“火车头”，玩个不停。所以夏夏的屎屎还是经常憋着。
驾！驾！驾！
page_text_en:
Mom had to buy Xiaxia a giraffe potty, hoping that as soon as she felt the urge, she would sit on the potty and go poop right away.
But Xiaxia treated the giraffe potty as a toy, sometimes pretending it was a 'little wooden horse,' and sometimes a 'train engine,' playing nonstop. So Xiaxia's poop still often got held in.
Vroom! Vroom! Vroom!
summary_zh: 妈妈为夏夏买了长颈鹿便盆，希望她能及时上厕所，但夏夏却把便盆当作玩具骑着玩，导致便意经常被憋住。

page_text_ocr_zh:
噗
这天，夏夏的尼尼来得特别急，
但长颈鹿便盆不见了！夏夏找遍了各
个地方都没发现长颈鹿便盆。
哎呀，憋不住了，就快憋不住了！
page_text_en:
Pfft
This day, Xiaxia's urge came on very suddenly,
but the giraffe potty was gone! Xiaxia searched everywhere
and couldn't find the giraffe potty.
Oh no, I can't hold it anymore, I'm about to burst!
summary_zh: 夏夏急需上厕所，却发现长颈鹿便盆不见了，她焦急地到处寻找，但怎么也找不到，快要憋不住了。

page_text_ocr_zh:
夏夏又着急又奇怪，为什么长颈鹿便盆会不见了呢？
是因为妈妈每次叫我拉尼尼时，我总说“再等一下”吗？
还是因为我每次吃饭只吃肉不吃青菜呢？或者是因为我常常忘记喝水，还特别爱吃饼干和巧克力糖？
page_text_en:
Xiaxia was anxious and puzzled: why had the giraffe potty disappeared?
Was it because every time Mom called me to go potty, I always said, 'Just a minute'?
Or was it because I only ate meat and never ate vegetables during meals? Or maybe because I often forgot to drink water and loved eating cookies and chocolate candy?
summary_zh: 夏夏焦急地寻找失踪的长颈鹿便盆，同时反思自己是否因为总是拖延上厕所、挑食和不爱喝水导致便盆‘逃跑’。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“你看到我的长颈鹿便盆了吗？”夏夏急匆匆地来问马桶先生。
马桶先生是长颈鹿便盆的好朋友，它每次都会收下长颈鹿便盆运送过来的屁屁，并快速地用水冲掉。
page_text_en:
"Have you seen my giraffe potty?" Xiaxia hurriedly asked Mr. Toilet.
Mr. Toilet is the good friend of the giraffe potty. He always takes the poop delivered by the giraffe potty and quickly flushes it away with water.
summary_zh: 夏夏焦急地在卫生间询问马桶先生是否见过她的长颈鹿便盆，马桶先生解释了自己与便盆的协作关系。

page_text_ocr_zh:
马桶先生有点儿不情愿地说：“最近长颈鹿便盆常常说你拉的屁屁硬邦邦的，砸得它好疼。它还说你拉屁屁总是要拉很久，压得它都快要喘不过气了，我猜它是悄悄逃跑了。”
夏夏脸红了，她确实觉得最近拉屁屁可费劲了，但真没想到长颈鹿便盆会逃跑啊！
page_text_en:
Mr. Toilet reluctantly said, "Recently, the giraffe potty has been complaining that your poop is hard and hurts it when it falls. It also said you take a long time to poop, pressing it until it can hardly breathe. I guess it quietly ran away." 
Xiaxia blushed. She did feel that pooping had been difficult lately, but she never thought the giraffe potty would run away!
summary_zh: 马桶先生告诉夏夏，长颈鹿便盆因为她的便便太硬、排便时间太长而感到痛苦，所以悄悄逃跑了。夏夏听后脸红了，意识到自己排便确实费劲，但没想到便盆会因此逃跑。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“上次它送来的屁屁差点儿堵塞了马桶！我用了很多水才把屁屁冲走，我还从没见过硬得像石头一样的屁屁！”
虽然马桶先生没完没了地抱怨了起来，但它总算让夏夏拉了屁屁。
啊啊啊
page_text_en:
"Last time, the poop it delivered almost clogged the toilet! I used a lot of water to flush it away. I've never seen poop as hard as a stone!"
Although the toilet先生 kept complaining endlessly, it finally helped Xiaxia go poop.
Ah ah ah
summary_zh: 马桶先生抱怨夏夏的便便太硬，差点堵塞马桶，虽然它抱怨不断，但最终还是让夏夏成功排便了。

page_text_ocr_zh:
上完厕所后，全家一起帮夏夏寻找长颈鹿便盆，总算在床底下找到了。
为了让长颈鹿便盆以后不再逃跑，全家人纷纷出主意。
妈妈说：“每天要定时拉尼尼，不要总是憋着。”
奶奶说：“不要挑食和偏食，营养要搭配好。”
爸爸说：“坚持多运动，还要多喝水，这样才能帮助尼尼快快拉出来。”
page_text_en:
After using the toilet, the whole family helped Xiaxia look for the giraffe potty, and finally found it under the bed.
To make sure the giraffe potty wouldn't run away again, everyone offered suggestions.
Mom said, "You should go to the bathroom at a fixed time every day, and don't always hold it in."
Grandma said, "Don't be picky or eat unbalanced meals; you need to have a well-balanced diet."
Dad said, "Keep exercising regularly, and drink more water, so that you can help 'Nini' come out quickly."
summary_zh: 夏夏上完厕所后，全家在床底下找到了失踪的长颈鹿便盆。为了防止便盆再次逃跑，妈妈、奶奶和爸爸分别提出了定时排便、均衡饮食和多运动多喝水的建议。

page_text_en: So, the whole family mobilized—"Did you poop today?" became Mom's catchphrase. Grandma also made a scientific meal plan for Xiaxia, requiring her to eat both meat and vegetables to ensure sufficient fiber intake, even if it meant eating sweet potatoes, which Xiaxia didn't like.
summary_zh: 全家开始为夏夏改善饮食，奶奶制定了包含肉类、蔬菜、水果和粗粮的科学食谱，以帮助她改善便秘问题。

page_text_en:
At first, Xiaxia still often forgot to go potty.
But Mom had a great idea. She and Xiaxia made a reward chart together. Every time Xiaxia went potty, she could earn a little red flower. When she collected enough red flowers, she could trade them for toys!
summary_zh: 夏夏一开始仍会忘记上厕所，妈妈便和她一起制定了积分榜，通过贴小红花的方式鼓励她按时排便，并承诺攒够一定数量可换取玩具。

page_text_en:
Dad also tells Xiaxia some scientific knowledge about the body every day.
Xiaxia learns more and more secrets about the body. After food is swallowed by the mouth, it travels down the esophagus into the stomach, then through the small intestine and large intestine, and finally exits through the anus—the leftover food residue after digestion becomes poop.

Food
Bowel movement
summary_zh: 爸爸每天给夏夏讲解身体消化系统的科学知识，夏夏了解到食物经过食管、胃、小肠、大肠后，残渣会变成大便排出体外。画面展示了爸爸和夏夏一起阅读，以及夏夏身体内部消化过程的示意图。

page_text_ocr_zh:
有时夏夏拉不出尼尼，奶奶还会给她吃一些促进消化的食物，比如香蕉、苹果。为了让身体更好地吸收营养，夏夏还养成了把饭菜细细咀嚼后再咽下的好习惯。
现在，夏夏每天都会顺利地拉出尼尼，积分榜上的小红花也越来越多啦！
page_text_en:
Sometimes when Xiaxia couldn't poop NiNi, Grandma would give her some foods that help digestion, like bananas and apples. To help her body absorb nutrients better, Xiaxia also developed the good habit of chewing her food thoroughly before swallowing.
Now, Xiaxia can poop NiNi smoothly every day, and there are more and more little red flowers on the reward chart!
summary_zh: 奶奶给夏夏吃香蕉、苹果等促进消化的食物，夏夏养成细嚼慢咽的习惯，现在每天都能顺利排便，积分榜上的小红花也越来越多。

不同，比如吃了红红的火龙果，就会拉出红红的尼尼。

page_text_en:
Welcome!
And Xiaxia discovered a secret about NiNi:
Eating foods of different colors can result in NiNi of different colors too. For example, if you eat bright red dragon fruit, you'll poop bright red NiNi.
Even more interesting, NiNi can have different shapes—sometimes like a banana, sometimes like a top, and sometimes like a pizza, a big sticky mess. Yuck!
summary_zh: 夏夏发现吃不同颜色的食物会影响大便的颜色和形状，比如吃火龙果会拉出红色大便，大便形状有时像香蕉、陀螺或比萨饼。

现在，长颈鹿便盆也不再逃跑了，它可喜欢夏夏软软的、金黄色的香蕉状便便了，马桶先生也很欢迎这样的便便，它再也不担心自己会被堵塞了。
香蕉状便便真好！这代表身体很健康哟！
“扑通”
page_text_en:
Now, the giraffe potty no longer runs away. It loves Xiaxia's soft, golden, banana-shaped poop. Mr. Toilet also welcomes this kind of poop and no longer worries about getting clogged.
Banana-shaped poop is great! It means the body is very healthy!
"Plop!"
summary_zh: 夏夏的排便问题得到改善，她现在能排出健康、香蕉状的便便，长颈鹿便盆和马桶先生都很高兴，画面中三人手拉手庆祝。
